title: SKU CPG Accelerator Spring 2027 Track
summary: SKU, an Austin CPG accelerator, runs a 12-week hybrid program open to brands nationwide and ending in a pitch showcase. Recent spring deadlines: Dec 12 (Spring '26), Dec 1 (Spring '25), Nov 19 (Spring '24). No Spring 2027 call published yet; expect a Nov-Dec 2026 deadline.
why_relevant: Leading Texas CPG accelerator with investor demo days; the likely application window falls within the next two months.

title: H-E-B Quest for Texas Best 2027
summary: H-E-B's annual competition for Texas-made food and beverage products, with prize money and a path to H-E-B shelves. Submission windows: Mar 11-Apr 22, 2026 and Mar 10-Apr 23, 2025. The 2027 call is not out yet; expect about March 2027.
why_relevant: Most direct Texas retail-plus-prize opportunity for a Houston beverage brand; prepare samples and story before March.

title: GO TEXAN Product Partner + MEGA Product Promotion Grants
summary: TDA's MEGA Product Promotion grants reimburse Tier 2+ GO TEXAN Product partners up to $40,000 for marketing of qualifying Texas products: tradeshow fees, ads, direct mail, websites. The 2026 round ran Mar 23-May 7, 2026, and members had to join or upgrade by Apr 21. The next round is not yet announced.
why_relevant: Non-dilutive Texas money that can pay trade-show and launch marketing costs; join GO TEXAN now to be eligible next round.

title: Expo West 2027 Launch Pad (emerging-brand exhibit area)
summary: Launch Pad is an application-based exhibit area at Expo West for CPG brands of a specific size and funding stage. Expo West 2027 is Mar 2-5 in Anaheim. Exhibitor applications need a non-refundable fee and a standards review of up to 90 days; products may not contain artificial colors, flavors or sweeteners. No 2027 deadline posted.
why_relevant: Cheapest route to an Expo West booth for an early brand; the 90-day review means applying soon.

title: Whole Foods Market Local and Emerging Accelerator Program (LEAP)
summary: LEAP's Early Growth track is a 12-week retail-readiness program for brands not yet sold at Whole Foods. The 2026 cohort received a $25,000 equity investment from a donor-advised fund managed by the Austin Community Foundation. Graduates are considered for local or regional shelf placement. 2026 applications opened Jun 2, 2026; the 2027 cycle is not announced.
why_relevant: Retailer program built for pre-shelf brands: mentorship, $25K equity and a path into Whole Foods.

title: KeHE ELEVATE New & Emerging Brands Program
summary: KeHE's program for new and emerging brands, capped at about 200 brands, pairs brands with KeHE category managers who advise on retail strategy and help win points of distribution. Brands can show at the KeHE Summer Show. KeHE says it is actively seeking candidates; applications historically ran through RangeMe.
why_relevant: Path into natural and specialty grocery distribution once Sooz has early velocity.

title: Iron Heart Canning expands mobile canning and co-packing to Texas
summary: Mobile canning and co-packing provider Iron Heart Canning now serves Texas through a 2026 partnership with Blue Flag Distillery, per a BevNET press release.
why_relevant: Possible in-state option for small canned beverage runs; confirm it handles non-alcoholic products and minimum order sizes.

title: Northhall FABID Q1 2026 CPG Funding Report
summary: Northhall's Q1 2026 report: about $340M went into food, beverage and CPG brands, down 13% from the prior quarter on fewer deals. Median check rose, Series A/B took a large share, and early-stage activity stayed constrained. Its Q2 2026 report says priorities on stage and deal structure are shifting.
why_relevant: Market context for pitch and round sizing: early-stage CPG money is scarce, so expect angel-led small checks.
